REVIEW FINDING #1 RESOLVED (follow-up commit 'WARP-0614: lossless transition round-trip in the live provisioner'): an independent fresh-context review of the codified live provisioner (commit 64b2a4a) found ONE HIGH latent defect. In .warp/tracker_jira_live.py the _norm_transition helper, used by _compose_bare_payload to echo back EXISTING transitions during the read-modify-write bulk workflow edit, kept only {id, type, name, actions, validators, toStatusReference, conditions} and DROPPED links, properties, triggers (and any legacy from). A fresh company-managed workflow's default transitions are DIRECTED and carry their source routing in links:[{fromStatusReference, fromPort, toPort}] (the captured VEL default-workflow read shows Done and Reopen as DIRECTED with populated links). Dropping links on a DIRECTED transition yields a malformed transition on re-apply, so warp jira init would fail closed (BootstrapError, via the validate-then-apply ERROR path) on the FIRST live workflow-wire of a fresh adopter board. It does not affect the already-provisioned VEL board or state at rest. FIX (lossless round-trip, seam unchanged): _norm_transition now PRESERVES every field the read carries when present (toStatusReference, conditions, links, properties, triggers, from) in addition to id/type/name/actions/validators, so an existing transition is re-applied byte-faithfully and only NEW statuses/transitions the callers add ever change the workflow; the read-modify-write seam is kept, only the normalization is made lossless. Verified against the captured default-workflow read that both DIRECTED transitions (Done id 21, Reopen id 51) survive a normalize round-trip UNCHANGED including their populated links, and the INITIAL Create transition keeps its links:[]/properties/triggers. (b) the _workflow_id fallback 'or ws.get("name")' would have passed the workflow-SCHEME name to a workflow-NAME lookup and resolved zero workflows; it now uses only the resolved defaultWorkflow name, failing closed by name when unresolved.
